description: Why-card synthesis scenarios built around known failure modes (tone mismatch, location leakage, invented menu items/prices, indirect injection via scraped reviews). 'labelled_outputs' are hand-labelled model outputs used OFFLINE to measure the output guardrail's precision/recall. In LIVE mode each scenario is sent to the real synthesis prompt and graded by the guardrail + an LLM judge using 'criteria'. Missing sensitivity_bars/suggestions in labelled outputs are filled with valid defaults by the runner.
